stories.title: Tokenizer
stories.so_that: I get a list of typed tokens
acceptance_criteria: Given '2 + 3', When tokenize, Then returns [NUMBER(2), PLUS, NUMBER(3)]
Given '(1.5 + 2) * 3', When tokenize, Then handles decimals and parens
Given '', When tokenize, Then returns empty list

stories.title: Parser and evaluator
acceptance_criteria: Given '2 + 3 * 4', When evaluate, Then returns 14.0 (precedence correct)
Given '1 / 0', When evaluate, Then raises CalcError

stories.title: Edge cases and safety
acceptance_criteria: Given '__import__("os")', When evaluate, Then raises CalcError
Given 'a' * 1001 characters, When evaluate, Then raises CalcError (input too long)
Given '-3 + 2', When evaluate, Then returns -1.0 (unary minus)
